notes.title: About This Test
notes.content:
About This Test


This is a time-limited open test. We may extend or shorten the duration based on your testing feedback. The main goal of this round is to test and adjust the stability of our AI service under a high volume of simultaneous users.



The current version uses Microsoft's AI service. Due to the high cost of real-time voice generation, we're unable to provide the highest quality AI voice from the demonstration video in this free test. We plan to integrate more large language models and voice services in the future to find a better balance between quality and cost.



The content available in this test is limited, specifically regarding gameplay and collectibles. We will adjust our development roadmap for future content based on the results of this test. We welcome all your valuable feedback and suggestions.
